source: Maayong aga sa tanan nga nag-atendir sang miting.
reference: Good morning to everyone who attended the meeting.

source: Kinahanglan naton aprubahan ang budget para sa masunod nga quarter.
reference: We need to approve the budget for the next quarter.

source: Si Maria ang responsable sa follow-up.
reference: Maria will be responsible for the follow-up.

source: May pamangkot bala parte sa agenda?
reference: Are there any questions about the agenda?

source: Salamat sa inyo nga oras. Tapos na ang miting.
reference: Thank you for your time. The meeting is over.

source: Indi gid naton magdesisyon subong kon wala pa ang report sang komite.
reference: We really should not decide today if the committee report is not yet available.

source: Maayong hapon; palihog i-record ang action item kay Ana antes magtapos ang miting.
reference: Good afternoon; please record the action item for Ana before the meeting ends.
